summary: The import sanity test only allows unchecked imports of certain libraries in certain directories; other imports must handle import errors, which also helps validate-modules and gives better user errors.
questions: What does the import sanity test check?

answer_card.title: import sanity test
answer_card.answer_md: Only specific libraries may be imported unchecked from specific directories. Any other import must handle `ImportError`, which supports tests like validate-modules and gives users clearer errors.
